description: Implementation of HashStore class for distributed key-value storage with synchronization, wait, compare-and-set, and queue operations in PyTorch's distributed module.

classes.name: HashStore
classes.description: A thread-safe distributed hash store with support for key-value operations, waiting, and queue management.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the HashStore object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value for a given key.

methods.name: compareSet
methods.description: Atomically compares and sets the value for a key if it matches the expected value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a set of keys to be available within a timeout.

methods.name: waitLocked
methods.description: Internal method to wait with a lock held.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an integer to the current value associated with a key.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the number of keys in the store.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if all specified keys exist or are queued.

methods.name: checkLocked
methods.description: Internal method to check keys with a lock held.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to the value of a key.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Pushes a value into a queue associated with a key.

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Pops a value from a queue associated with a key, optionally blocking.

methods.name: queueLen
methods.description: Returns the length of the queue for a key.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys in the store.
